title: Acceptance probability of a uniform tester mixture
statement: Let $t>0$, and let $T_1,\ldots,T_t$ be nonadaptive function testers with the same domain, codomain, and number of query positions. For any function $f$ from that domain to that codomain, the acceptance probability of the tester obtained by choosing one of these testers uniformly and then using its seed distribution equals the uniform average of their individual acceptance probabilities on $f$.
hypotheses_covered: The family consists of $t$ nonadaptive function testers with common domain, codomain, and query count
$f$ maps the common domain to the common codomain
